item.title: Elder Cornelius Emanuel Johnson
item.description: Elder Johnson was a devoted and faithful member of the Church of God, he served God and his community with humility, joy, and unwavering commitment. Read more: Elder Cornelius Emanuel Johnson

item.title: New Walmart in Ocala gets green light on standalone liquor store at site
item.description: The Ocala City Council has cleared the way for a new Walmart Neighborhood Market in southeast Ocala to sell beer, wine, and liquor when it opens in the coming weeks. Read more: New Walmart in Ocala gets green light on standalone liquor store at site

item.title: David William Klimasewski Sr.
item.description: David Klimasewski Sr. served in the Navy for 20 years. He received commendations from his military service. He enjoyed being a part of a Christian Motorcycle Association and he was a part of the American Legion. Read more: David William Klimasewski Sr.

item.title: Ocala woman arrested outside Dollar General for ramming car occupied by children
item.description: An Ocala woman, who was upset about children being left unattended in a running vehicle outside a local Dollar General, was arrested after she allegedly rammed her car into another woman’s vehicle while the children were inside. Read more: Ocala woman arrested outside Dollar General for ramming car occupied by children

item.title: Virgil Loius Briggs, Jr.
item.description: Virgil Briggs, Jr. loved fishing and hunting. He played Country Music in Wooster (The Shelmar Opry) and in Florida on Friday afternoon Jam Session. Read more: Virgil Loius Briggs, Jr.

item.title: Ocala man sues Downtown Billiards after alleged assault by unlicensed bouncer
item.description: A man is suing a pool hall in downtown Ocala for negligence, claiming he was beaten by an unlicensed security guard who he alleges has a history of aggression. Read more: Ocala man sues Downtown Billiards after alleged assault by unlicensed bouncer

item.description: The Ocala Police Department is investigating a homicide that occurred near the city's Historic District on Wednesday, marking the first such incident of the new year. Read more: Fatal shooting near Ocala Historic District being investigated by police
